settings.question: When will I get my tracking number?
settings.answer: As soon as your order ships — usually within 2–3 working days — we'll email / SMS your tracking number.

settings.question: Picked up from our studio?
settings.answer: Store pickup orders show in your account as well. You'll get a message when your order is ready to collect.

settings.question: Something wrong with your delivery?
settings.answer: Contact us with your order number and we'll sort it out.
